PORTRAIT 9:16 loading-screen illustration, ONE image only, ideally 1440 x 2560 PNG. The portrait orientation and generous full-body framing are essential.
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one completely new portrait composition using the provided APPROVED landscape image as the exact character, action, environment, color and lighting reference. Preserve the same approved moment without reinterpreting the story. This is a reference for a new whole image, not a mask edit, collage or cropped landscape.
Reference role: Image 1 is the approved #807 loading artwork. Keep precisely this young emperor Puyi's face, mischievous over-the-shoulder smile toward the camera, running stride, ONE black center-back braid, black hat with red crown and small gold finial, golden-yellow robe AND separate billowing golden cape, blue-gray dragon/cloud and wave embroidery, navy cuffs/collar, black belt with gold medallions, charcoal trousers and black boots with pale soles. Keep the cape shape and flow sweeping behind him as in the reference. Keep the beautiful stylized 3D appearance, not a new realistic human, adult, costume, or character. Same sunlit red-walled Forbidden City alley, yellow tiled roofs, gray paving and light direction.
Composition is deliberately pulled BACK relative to the supplied landscape: the COMPLETE emperor from gold hat finial through both boots must occupy ONLY the middle roughly 50 to 53 percent of the portrait image height. The gold hat finial is near y=22% and the lowest boot near y=73%; face around x=56%, y=31%. The entire billowing cape and both hands fit comfortably inside the image width with side margins. Do not enlarge the character to fill the height. He runs forward and glances back over his shoulder exactly as in the approved picture; keep his expression clearly readable.
Add substantial natural scene above and below: the upper 20% contains blue sky and the yellow palace roofs above the red alley walls; below his feet the bottom 25% to 27% is EMPTY QUIET unobstructed stone-paved alley, a low-detail area ready for a later game title. Absolutely no title in the generated image.
Centered 3:4 crop safety is mandatory: a crop of the middle 75% of this 9:16 image height, removing the outer top 12.5% and bottom 12.5%, must retain the COMPLETE emperor including finial, both feet, hands and cape, with visible sky/roofs above and some calm paving below. Keep every part of him within the middle y=20% to 75% safe zone. Do not place hat or feet near the portrait borders.
Camera: same close rear-quarter/side tracking viewpoint and turned face as the approved artwork, simply pulled back for the specified portrait composition. Keep emperor sharply focused with strong directional/radial speed blur along the outer side walls and edges, tapering toward the sharp character; central lower title area stays visually calm.
No change of action, face, costume, cape color, hat or time of day. Only one emperor in an empty alley. No drone visible, no people, eunuchs or guards, collectibles, obstacles, props, writing, letters, logos, watermarks, UI, buttons, borders or collage. A single finished tall 9:16 illustration, never a landscape image.
